about: The evening outcome ask's fixed question, read by plugins/av-events/_outcome_ask.py, by the trigger's questionSha256 (skills/index-network/scripts/outcome-ask.ts) and by install/tests/proactive_jobs.test.ts. The plugin arms only when the model's reply, after the normalise steps (for matching only; the message hash is of the reply as it is), fully matches ^sentence$ AND the SHA-256 of its question key equals the stage's question_sha256, which the trigger computes from the exact question it showed. A Telegram reply pointer's quote is searched for sentence to tell which ask it replies to. Both suites check every entry of cases.
sentence: Did you and [^?\n]{1,64} meet\? [Rr][Ee][Pp][Ll][Yy] met, not useful, or missed\.?

steps: spaces: each of these characters becomes a plain space
trailing_emoji: strip trailing emoji (Unicode category So, ZWJ, variation selectors, keycap mark, skin tones, tag characters) and whitespace
wrapper: remove one pair of these around the whole reply, the first that fits, if anything is left inside
trailing_emoji: again, for emoji inside the wrapper

key.about: The question key: the normalise spaces as plain spaces; every character of remove deleted; each run of whitespace (ASCII space, tab, newline, carriage return, form feed, vertical tab) as one space; stripped of spaces; one final full stop removed; lower-cased by Unicode default lower case (Python str.lower, TypeScript toLowerCase). Its plain SHA-256 (UTF-8) is the stage's question_sha256; its keyed hash is the ask's question_hash.
